data.title: 摩根 · 冬之玉座的居高凝视
data.action: 倚在黑曜石雕花床柱旁，修长双腿在薄纱高衩下展露无遗，银白长发被蓝缎带系起，冷艳高傲的紫瞳凝视着御主。
data.location: 不列颠卡美洛王宫寝殿，高耸哥特花窗外飘散着终年不息的白垩冷雾
data.lighting: 银蓝色的魔法冷光在地面流淌，银烛台跳跃着微弱冷焰，勾勒出如冰霜雕刻的躯体轮廓
data.mood: 至高女王的绝对支配欲与面对伴侣时的清冷深情
data.description: 不列颠卡美洛王宫寝殿，高耸哥特花窗外飘散着终年不息的白垩冷雾。倚在黑曜石雕花床柱旁，修长双腿在薄纱高衩下展露无遗，银白长发被蓝缎带系起，冷艳高傲的紫瞳凝视着御主。 她微微抬眸轻语——“我的妻子……或者说我的丈夫。在女王的床榻前，你应当清楚现在谁才是支配者。”
data.promptProse: Seated with icy regal poise upon an obsidian throne inside Camelot's vaulted winter chambers, Morgan le Fay wears a sheer layered ice-blue peignoir with a thigh-high slit over a silver-embroidered black bandeau. Framed against towering stained glass and endless white winter fog, she gleams in silver candlelight and cold blue magic.
data.animaCaption: Seated imperiously upon an obsidian throne in a sheer ice-blue layered peignoir parted high along her legs over a silver-embroidered black bandeau, she fixes the viewer with an icy sovereign stare. Pale winter fog beyond gothic stained glass and cold blue magic light rim her figure.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ice-blue sheer layered floor-length peignoir with a thigh-high slit draped over a dark silver-embroidered filigree bandeau.
